concept.concept: Bold black canvas design with a grinning Jack-o-lantern and the text 'Candy Acquisition Device' in stencil-style lettering
concept.audience: Parents buying for kids and adults who trick-or-treat ironically, Halloween enthusiasts
concept.rationale: Tote as trick-or-treat bag is a direct functional use case driving purchase intent; 'Candy Acquisition Device' is funny and shareable; Halloween is the dominant seasonal driver in this buying window; functional+humorous products have strong conversion rates

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "CANDY ACQUISITION DEVICE" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a large grinning jack-o-lantern with exaggerated triangular eyes and a wide carved smile, solid black with sharp clean edges, centered composition. Bold stencil-style lettering reading 'CANDY ACQUISITION DEVICE' arched below the pumpkin in all caps. Color palette: solid black artwork, white background. Screen-print aesthetic, no gradients, no shading, no detail. High contrast, readable from across a room. Single centered image on plain white background with generous margins.
design.style: flat vector illustration, bold stencil-style lettering, screen-print aesthetic, solid black and white, high contrast, sharp edges, no gradients

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Candy Acquisition Device' is a generic humorous descriptive phrase with no known trademark registration or association with any brand, celebrity, or protected IP. The Jack-o-lantern is a universal public domain Halloween symbol. The stencil-style lettering is a common design aesthetic. No elements of this design reference any registered trademarks, brand names, characters, slogans, or other protected intellectual property. The concept is a straightforward Halloween humor design that falls within safe generic territory.
